description: Native bucket-ladder smoke: train a scratch 16-king-bucket Enyo net on Stockfish binpack through Bullet before spending more compute on 32 buckets. This tests the small-data NNUE advice that fewer input buckets may learn better with available data. It is checkpoint-gated, not a promotion candidate.

metadata.hypothesis: The current 32-bucket native scratch layout is data-starved. A 16-bucket scratch net should learn a stronger exported representation on the same SF-binpack recipe if bucket count is the bottleneck.

validation.checkpoint_gate: sweep checkpoints 512,1024,1536,2048 against cached broad/search gates before any SPRT
validation.stop_condition: reject this bucket rung if checkpoints repeat 32-bucket broad move-choice collapse or mate-like catastrophic tails
validation.promotion: not eligible for SPRT without passing checkpoint search gates and failure replay
